heroImage.licenseNote: Aerial of the south end of Guarujá, taken 2022-01-02. Praia do Guaiúba is the sheltered cove in the foreground; Praia do Tombo and the city are beyond the headland. Shows the beach itself and the exact geography the piece describes, rather than a generic beach shot. 3000x1686 native, so it clears the Discover card spec uncropped.

statusHistory.note: First piece drafted from the Santos → Guaiúba cluster research pass scoped in BACKLOG.md 2026-09-02, and the Product Trio's Must-on-dependency for this batch — the route piece and the CICLOVIA collection both need a destination pin to link to. Geocode is a real Nominatim hit on the OSM natural=beach feature (-24.0176, -46.2924), not an approximate placement. Trust set to auto rather than review despite having originated in an operator-named target: the trust-gate exists to stop an operator-recalled venue publishing unverified, and the verification concern is fully discharged here — this is a public municipal beach with an OSM feature, a Guarujá tourism-portal listing, and a CETESB bathing-water classification, none of which can quietly have closed or rebranded. Flagged to the operator in the same session rather than downgraded silently. Hero resolved by near-illustrator at tier 1 (real, correctly-located photograph) — Commons has no photo of the Guaiúba calçadão or its kiosks, and the 'GUAIUBA GUARUJÁ - panoramio' file set is unreliable by filename (one of them is a vermilion flycatcher on a concrete block, nothing to do with the beach), so both images here were checked visually before use. Deliberately did NOT publish a citywide Santos bike-network figure — see the sourcing warning in BACKLOG.md. In-body image floor (250 words per image) wants three images for a 717-word body and this has two; the missing one is a shot of the kiosks and the portuguese-stone calçadão, which does not exist under a usable licence and is logged in content/photo-requests.md rather than padded with a duplicate sunset.
